intent: Match the existing Ocarina of Time art using original painted assets, scene lighting, restrained particle colors and feathered effects.

coverage.equipment: Shared material treatment for 12 base appearances, 6 modifier appearances, 20 unique/set appearances, bow and hammer, socket material drops, and held/worn/pickup variants.
coverage.combat: Every active skill and rune uses original trail, dust, flame, lightning or flash textures; seven aura forms use restrained trails and motes with child scaling.
coverage.other_effects: Arsenal and adventure relic procs, healing tethers, Warden warnings, quest interaction rings and brood webs use the shared textured effect state.
coverage.creatures: Native-painted material detail on the existing custom Stalfos, Wolfos, Lizalfos/Dinolfos, Tektite, Deku Baba and Keese meshes, plus sentinels, wraiths and brood shells.
coverage.quest_props: Original rock, crate, torch and gravestone models replace the artificial ore crystals, parcel boxes and lantern-like memorials. Timber and the spring use painted material detail; prior foliage work is retained.

preserved: Gameplay hit shapes, timings, rewards, saves, item powers, actor rigs and equipment attachment transforms.
review_limits: Representative native views cover daytime, overcast and nighttime; this is not a manual review of every animation, camera angle, room or texture-pack combination.
The existing painted inventory icons were audited and retained.
The first skill integration run reached the champion-pack test with its QA profile enemy toggle off. The fresh rerun with enemies enabled passed all 370 checks.

production_build.startup_check: passed: ordinary Nintendo boot and Zelda title screen in the isolated profile
